mab

The package mab is a collection of functions related to movement and habitat selection analyses. It also includes a few patches for functions from the adehabitat package family (notably adehabitatLT and adehabitatHR).

Installation

Install mab from CRAN:

install.packages("mab")

To install the package from GitHub (which may be ahead of CRAN from time to time), use the package remotes or better pak to install mab:

remotes::install_github("basille/mab")
pak::pkg_install("basille/mab")
